kind: Historical controlled observations; no API requests were made while packaging.
scope: Archive supplement. These are not results from the current two-fixture K1-K5 runner.

provenance.extraction: Only explicit scalar allowlists were copied from the archived aggregate and score records. Summary totals and means were checked against those records. Raw private artifacts are not included.
provenance.reproduction_limit: These public scalars support arithmetic checks, not independent replay of the original provider calls.

settings.final_recovery: Common developer instructions + one checkpoint + hidden quiz. No retained user messages, history tail, generation reasoning, previous response reference or conversation reference.
settings.text_replay: Controlled text arms include the Codex summary prefix. Historical handoff replays literal visible text without that prefix.

historical_claude_code.difference_from_current_snapshot: Historical line: [User feedback on the error if any]. Current line: [User feedback on the fix, if any].

historical_handoff.difference_from_current_snapshot: Historical prompt has fewer blank lines and no final text-only/no-tool-call instruction.

workload.scoring: Exact whole-answer match; task answers require state, receipt and next action. Unknown questions require abstention.
workload.independence: Four independent holdout seeds. Two independent compressions per fixture, not sequential recompaction. Questions and repeated compressions within a fixture are correlated.
workload.token_measure: Provider marginal replay input versus the same developer instructions and quiz-only control, after removing input attribution attached to newly generated output items. Native replay was independently cross-checked against item attribution. No ciphertext-length token estimate.

four_way_high_density.reuse: Builtin text and native default reuse the high-density holdout cells. The two text-prompt extensions use the same fixtures with fresh compressions; they are not a new blinded holdout.

explicit_discard_sensitivity.added_instruction: Both methods are told before the unchanged builtin compaction prompt that all earlier messages and tool results will be discarded, external recovery is unavailable, and every authoritative association remains in scope. The hidden quiz is not disclosed.

historical_handoff.conversion_input: Retained user messages U + the same native checkpoint T + historical handoff prompt. Only final recovery is checkpoint-only.
historical_handoff.retention_measure: Budget is ceil(UTF-8 bytes/4) per content part. One boundary user message is middle-truncated. The truncation marker is outside the 64000 budget; 64007 is an estimate, not provider input accounting.
historical_handoff.retry: Only the interrupted conversion was retried with the identical request and native checkpoint. Its partial response and usage are unavailable. Completed artifacts were not regenerated.

limitations: One model, provider, source-prompt version and synthetic exact-state workload; no coding continuation or third-party reader evaluation.
Four seeds are the independent holdout units. Prompt extensions and later sensitivity/handoff stages reuse those seeds. Exhaustive quizzes reuse one predetermined artifact per method.
Calibration used one other seed and 12 checkpoints; it is excluded from holdout totals.
Low density and explicit-discard sensitivity are counterexamples to a universal native-quality advantage.
No equal-budget frontier, multi-cycle recompaction or causal isolation of encryption.
Input totals include cached input; reported reasoning is part of output. Zero native reasoning usage does not establish zero hidden work. Token figures are not dollar costs.

Historical Claude Code and handoff prompts differ from the current prompt snapshots. The historical standard-text prompt matches the packaged standard snapshot, but these runs still use the historical settings and fixture protocol.
